74300.meaning1: reaches the heart; obtains the essence; gets to the core; finds the substance
74300.commentary: (UDa) upātidhāvanti na sāram'entī'ti sīla-samādhi-paññā-vimutti-ādi-bhedaṃ sāraṃ na enti, catusacc'ābhisamayavasena na adhigacchanti. tasmiṃ pana saupāye sāre tiṭṭhante'y'eva vimutt'ābhilāsāya taṃ upentā viya hutvā'pi diṭṭhivipallāsena atidhāvanti atikkamitvā gacchanti, pañc'upādānakkhandhe niccaṃ subhaṃ sukhaṃ attā'ti abhinivisitvā gaṇhantā'ti attho.

examples.text: upātidhāvanti na sāram'enti, navaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ brūhayanti, patanti pajjotam'iv'ādhipātakā, diṭṭhe sute iti'h'eke niviṭṭhā'ti.
tato kīṭe paṭaṅ'ge ca, yāva kunthakipillike, liṅgaṃ jātimayaṃ tesaṃ, aññam'aññā hi jātiyo.

74302.meaning1: (of the sun) rises; ascends; comes up

examples.text: obhāsati tāva so kimi, yāva na uggamati pabhaṅ'karo, sa verocanamhi uggate, hatappabho hoti na c'āpi bhāsati.

74305.commentary: (UDa) obhāsati tāva so kimī'ti so khajjūpanakakimi tāva'd'eva obhāsati jotati dibbati.

examples.text: obhāsati tāva so kimi, yāva na unnamate pabhaṅ'karo, sa verocanamhi uggate, hatappabho hoti na c'āpi bhāsati.

74306.commentary: (UDa) evaṃ obhāsitam'eva takkikānan'ti yathā tena khajjūpanakena sūriy'uggamanato pure'y'eva obhāsitaṃ hoti, evaṃ takketvā vitakketvā parikappanamattena diṭṭhīnaṃ gahaṇato takkikā'ti laddhanāmehi titthiyehi obhāsitaṃ attano samayatejena dīpetvā adhiṭṭhitaṃ tāva, yāva sammāsambuddhā loke n'uppajjanti.

examples.text: evaṃ obhāsitam'eva takkikānaṃ, yāva sammāsambuddhā loke n'uppajjanti, na takkikā sujjhanti na c'āpi sāvakā, duddiṭṭhī na dukkhā pamuccare'ti.

74307.meaning1: with light killed; with radiance destroyed
74307.commentary: (UDa) sa verocanamhi uggate, hatappabho hoti na c'āpi bhāsatī'ti samantato andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā kiraṇasahassena virocanasabhāvatāya verocananāmake ādicce uṭṭhite so khajjūpanako hatappabho nittejo kāḷako hoti, ratt'andhakāre viya na bhāsati na dibbati.

examples.text: obhāsati tāva so kimi, yāva na unnamate pabhaṅ'karo, sa verocanamhi uggate, hatappabho hoti na c'āpi bhāsati.

74308.synonym: ādicca, divākara, pabhaṅkara, bhāṇumant, ravi, sataraṃsī, suriya, sūriya, harissa
74308.commentary: (UDa) sa verocanamhi uggate, hatappabho hoti na c'āpi bhāsatī'ti samantato andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā kiraṇasahassena virocanasabhāvatāya verocananāmake ādicce uṭṭhite so khajjūpanako hatappabho nittejo kāḷako hoti, ratt'andhakāree viya na bhāsati na dibbati.

examples.text: obhāsati tāva so kimi, yāva na unnamate pabhaṅ'karo, sa verocanamhi uggate, hatappabho hoti na c'āpi bhāsati.

74310.meaning1: was cut; was cut off; was severed

examples.text: acchijji vaṭṭaṃ byagā nirāsaṃ, visukkhā saritā na sandati, chinnaṃ vaṭṭaṃ na vattati, es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
acchecchi vaṭṭaṃ byagā nirāsaṃ, visukkhā saritā na sandati, chinnaṃ vaṭṭaṃ na vattati, es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.

74313.commentary: (UDa) sammattakajātā'ti kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjantā appasukhavedanāya sammattakā suṭṭhu mattakā jātā. sammodakajātā'ti'pi pāṭho, jātasammodanā uppannapahaṃsā'ti attho. sabbehi'pi padehi tesaṃ taṇh'ādhipannataṃ'y'eva vadati. ettha ca paṭhamaṃ kāmesū'ti vatvā puna'pi kāmesū'ti vacanaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tadadhimuttidīpan'atthaṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyā manussā yebhuyyena kāmesu ativelaṃ sattā rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā sammattakajātā kāmesu viharanti.

74314.commentary: (UDa) sammattakajātā'ti kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjantā appasukhavedanāya sammattakā suṭṭhu mattakā jātā. sammodakajātā'ti'pi pāṭho, jātasammodanā uppannapahaṃsā'ti attho. sabbehi'pi padehi tesaṃ taṇh'ādhipannataṃ'y'eva vadati. ettha ca paṭhamaṃ kāmesū'ti vatvā puna'pi kāmesū'ti vacanaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tadadhimuttidīpan'atthaṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyā manussā yebhuyyena kāmesu ativelaṃ sattā rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā sammattakajātā kāmesu viharanti.

74315.meaning1: bound by the bond of sensual desire; attached by the clasp of sensual pleasures
74315.commentary: (UDa) kāmasaṅgasattā'ti tā'y'eva kāmasattiyā vatthukāmesu rāgasaṅgena c'eva diṭṭhi-māna-dosa-avijjā-saṅgehi ca sattā āsattā.

examples.text: kāmesu sattā kāmasaṅgasattā, saṃyojane vajjam'apassamānā, na hi jātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā, oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantan'ti.

74316.meaning1: not seeing the fault (of); not understanding the problem (with)
74316.commentary: (UDa) saṃyojane vajjam'apassamānā'ti kammavaṭṭaṃ vipākavaṭṭena, bhav'ādike vā bhav'antar'ādīhi, satte vā dukkhehi saṃyojanato bandhanato saṃyojananāmake kāmarāg'ādikilesajāte saṃyojanīyesu dhammesu assād'ānupassitāya vaṭṭadukkhamūlabhāv'ādikaṃ vajjaṃ dosaṃ ādīnavaṃ apassantā.

examples.text: kāmesu sattā kāmasaṅgasattā, saṃyojane vajjam'apassamānā, na hi jātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā, oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantan'ti.

74317.grammar: prp of na passati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: kāmesu sattā kāmasaṅgasattā, saṃyojane vajjam'apassamānā, na hi jātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā, oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantan'ti.

74318.meaning1: fact of observing; fact of following; fact of seeing (as)
74318.construction:
anu + passa + ī + tā
anupassī + tā

examples.text: katame dve? yā ca saṃyojaniyesu dhammesu assāda-anupassitā, yā ca saṃyojaniyesu dhammesu nibbidā-anupassitā. saṃyojaniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu assāda'ānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ na pajahati, dosaṃ na pajahati, mohaṃ na pajahati.

74319.meaning1: bound fast by bonds and fetters; attached by ties and chains; (comm) bound by the ties that are bonds
74319.commentary: (UDa) na hi jātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā, oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantan'ti evaṃ ādīnavadassan'ābhāvena saṃyojanasabhāvesu saṅgesu, saṃyojanasaṅkhātehi vā saṅgehi tesaṃ visayesu tebhūmakadhammesu sattā vipulavisayatāya anādikālatāya ca vipulaṃ vitthiṇṇaṃ mahantañ'ca kām'ādioghaṃ, saṃsār'ogham'eva vā na kadāci tareyyuṃ, ek'aṃsen'eva tassa oghassa pāraṃ na gaccheyyun'ti attho.

examples.text: kāmesu sattā kāmasaṅgasattā, saṃyojane vajjam'apassamānā, na hi jātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā, oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantan'ti.

74320.meaning1: goes to old age and death; follows aging and dying
74320.commentary: (UDa) yathā kiṃ? macchā'va kumināmukhe yathā nāma macchabandhakena oḍḍitassa kuminassa mukhe paviṭṭhā macchā tena baddhā hutvā maraṇam'anventi pāpuṇanti, evam'eva mārena oḍḍitena kāmaguṇabandhanena baddhā ime sattā jarāmaraṇam'anventi.

examples.text: kām'andhā jālasañchannā, taṇhāchadanachāditā, pamattabandhunā baddhā, macchā'va kumināmukhe, jarāmaraṇam'anventi, vaccho khīrapako'va mātaran'ti.

74321.meaning1: bond and fetter; tie and chain; (comm) bond that is a fetter
74321.commentary: (DHPa) saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā'ti dasavidhena saṃyojanasaṅgena c'eva sattavidhena rāgasaṅg'ādinā ca sattā baddhā tasmiṃ vā laggā hutvā. (UDa) na hi jātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā, oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantan'ti evaṃ ādīnavadassan'ābhāvena saṃyojanasabhāvesu saṅgesu, saṃyojanasaṅkhātehi vā saṅgehi tesaṃ visayesu tebhūmakadhammesu sattā vipulavisayatāya anādikālatāya ca vipulaṃ vitthiṇṇaṃ mahantañ'ca kām'ādioghaṃ, saṃsār'ogham'eva vā na kadāci tareyyuṃ, ek'aṃsen'eva tassa oghassa pāraṃ na gaccheyyun'ti attho.

examples.text: kāmesu sattā kāmasaṅgasattā, saṃyojane vajjam'apassamānā, na hi jātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā, oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantan'ti.

74322.commentary: (UDa) jālasañchannā'ti sakattabhāvaparattabhāvesu ajjhattikabāhir'āyatanesu, tannissitesu ca dhammesu atīt'ādi-vasena anekabhedabhinnesu heṭṭh'upariyavasena apar'āparaṃ uppattiyā ant'ogadhānaṃ anatth'āvahato ca jālabhūtāya taṇhāya sukhumacchiddena jālena parivuto viya udakarahado sañchannā paliguṇṭhitā ajjhotthaṭā.

examples.text: kām'andhā jālasañchannā, taṇhāchadanachāditā, pamattabandhunā baddhā, macchā'va kumināmukhe, jarāmaraṇam'anventi, vaccho khīrapako'va mātaran'ti.

74323.meaning1: enveloped by a net; ensnared in the netting (of lust)
74323.commentary: (UDa) jālasañchannā'ti sakattabhāvaparattabhāvesu ajjhattikabāhir'āyatanesu, tannissitesu ca dhammesu atīt'ādi-vasena anekabhedabhinnesu heṭṭh'upariyavasena apar'āparaṃ uppattiyā ant'ogadhānaṃ anatth'āvahato ca jālabhūtāya taṇhāya sukhumacchiddena jālena parivuto viya udakarahado sañchannā paliguṇṭhitā ajjhotthaṭā.

examples.text: kām'andhā jālasañchannā, taṇhāchadanachāditā, pamattabandhunā baddhā, macchā'va kumināmukhe, jarāmaraṇam'anventi, vaccho khīrapako'va mātaran'ti.

74325.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in long standing; the Buddha's first monastic disciple; first person to realize the Buddha's teaching

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā aññātakoṇḍañño bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ paccavekkhamāno.

74326.meaning1: abandoning the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs; giving up classification of diverse perceptions
74326.commentary: (UDa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpahānan'ti papañcenti yattha sayaṃ uppannā, taṃ santānaṃ vitthārenti ciraṃ ṭhapentī'ti papañcā, kilesā. visesato rāgadosamohataṇhādiṭṭhimānā. tathā hi vuttaṃ, rāgo papañco, doso papañco, moho papañco, taṇhā papañco, diṭṭhi papañco, māno papañco'ti. apica saṃkiles'aṭṭho papañc'aṭṭho, kacavar'aṭṭho papañc'aṭṭho. tattha rāgapapañcassa subhasaññā nimittaṃ, dosapapañcassa āghātavatthu, mohapapañcassa āsavā, taṇhāpapañcassa vedanā, diṭṭhipapañcassa saññā, mānapapañcassa vitakko nimittaṃ. tehi papañcehi sahagatā saññā papañcasaññā. papañcasaññānaṃ saṅkhā bhāgā koṭṭhāsā papañcasaññāsaṅkhā. atthato saddhiṃ nimittehi taṃtaṃpapañcassa pakkhiyo kilesagaṇo. saññāgahaṇañ'c'ettha tassa nesaṃ sādhāraṇahetubhāvena. vuttañ'h'etaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā'ti. tesaṃ pahānaṃ, tena tena maggena rāg'ādikilesānaṃ samucchedanan'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā attano papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpahānaṃ paccavekkhamāno nisinno hoti.

74327.commentary: (UDa) thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo'ti puratthimadakkhiṇāya disāya majjhimadesassa avadhiṭṭhāne malladese thūṇanāmako brāhmaṇabahulatāya brāhmaṇagāmo.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūnaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
tena kho pana samayena rañño utenassa uyyānagatassa antepuraṃ daḍḍhaṃ hoti, pañca ca itthisatāni kālaṅ'katāni honti sāmāvatīpamukhāni.

74329.commentary: (UDa) sāmāvatīpamukhānī'ti ettha kā pan'āyaṃ sāmāvatī, kathañ'ca daḍḍhā'ti? vuccate, bhaddavatiyaṃ seṭṭhino dhītā ghosakaseṭṭhinā dhītuṭṭhāne ṭhapitā pañcasata-itthiparivārā rañño utenassa aggamah'esī mettāvihārabahulā ariyasāvikā sāmāvatī nāma. ayam'ettha saṅkhepo, vitthārato pana ādito paṭṭhāya sāmāvatiyā uppattikathā dhammapadavatthumhi (dha. pa. aṭṭha. 1.20 sāmāvatīvatthu) vuttanayena veditabbā.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghosit'ārāme. tena kho pana samayena rañño utenassa uyyānagatassa antepuraṃ daḍḍhaṃ hoti, pañca ca itthisatāni kālaṅ'katāni honti sāmāvatīpamukhāni.

74330.meaning1: name of King Udena's first queen

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghosit'ārāme. tena kho pana samayena rañño utenassa uyyānagatassa antepuraṃ daḍḍhaṃ hoti, pañca ca itthisatāni kālaṅ'katāni honti sāmāvatīpamukhāni.

74331.meaning1: bound by delusion; fettered by illusion
74331.commentary: (UDa) mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissatī'ti… so'pi mohasambandhano mohena paliguṇṭhito attahit'āhitaṃ ajānanto hite na paṭipajjati, ahitaṃ dukkh'āvahaṃ bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ ācināti.

examples.text: mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissati, upadhibandhano bālo, tamasā parivārito, sassato'riva khāyati, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.

74332.meaning1: bound by appropriation; tied by identification

examples.text: mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissati, upadhisambandhano bālo, tamasā parivārito, sassato'riva khāyati, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.

74333.meaning1: bound by appropriation; tied by identification
74333.commentary: (UDa) upadhibandhano bālo, tamasā parivārito. sassato'riva khāyatī'ti na kevalañ'ca mohasambandhano eva, apica kho upadhibandhano'pi ayaṃ andhabālaloko avijjātamasā parivārito.

examples.text: mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissati, upadhibandhano bālo, tamasā parivārito, sassato'riva khāyati, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.

taṃ cakkacchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati. ayaṃ, bhante, kukuṭṭhā nadī avidūre acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā set'odakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā. ettha bhagavā pānīyañ'ca pivissati gattāni ca sītīkarissatī'ti.

74337.meaning1: from the village of Pāṭalī; living in Pāṭalī village
74337.commentary: (UDa) pāṭaligāmiyā'ti pāṭaligāmavāsino upāsakā. te kira bhagavato paṭhamadassanena keci saraṇesu, keci sīlesu, keci saraṇesu ca sīlesu ca patiṭṭhitā. tena vuttaṃ upāsakā'ti.

examples.text: assosuṃ kho pāṭaligāmiyā upāsakā, bhagavā kira magadhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pāṭaligāmaṃ anuppatto'ti.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato nāgasamālassa tena panthena gacchantassa antarāmagge corā nikkhamitvā hatthehi ca pādehi ca ākoṭesuṃ pattañ'ca bhindiṃsu saṅghāṭiñ'ca vipphālesuṃ.

74339.commentary: (UDa) misso aññajanena vedagū'ti… attano hit'āhitaṃ na jānātī'ti añño, avidvā bālo'ti attho. tena aññena janena misso sahacaraṇamattena misso.

examples.text: saddhiṃ caram'ekato vasaṃ, misso aññajanena vedagū, vidvā pajahāti pāpakaṃ, koñco khīrapako'va ninnagan'ti.

74340.synonym: andha, apaṇḍita, avicakkhaṇa, aviddasu, duppañña, duppaññajātika, dummedha, dummedhī, nippañña, bāla, bālavant, magabhūta, mūḷharūpa
74340.commentary: (UDa) misso aññajanena vedagū'ti… attano hit'āhitaṃ na jānātī'ti añño, avidvā bālo'ti attho. tena aññena janena misso sahacaraṇamattena misso.

examples.text: saddhiṃ caram'ekato vasaṃ, misso aññajanena vedagū, vidvā pajahāti pāpakaṃ, koñco khīrapako'va ninnagan'ti.

74341.synonym: ambu, uda, udaka, oka, oda, odaka, ka, jala, toya, daka, vāri, salila
74341.commentary: (UDa) yathā kiṃ? koñco khīrapako'va ninnagan'ti yathā koñcasakuṇo udakamissite khīre upanīte vinā toyaṃ khīramattass'eva pivanato khīrapako ninnaṭṭhānagamanena ninnagasaṅkhātaṃ udakaṃ pajahāti vajjeti, evaṃ paṇḍito kira duppaññapuggalehi ṭhānanisajj'ādīsu sahabhūto'pi ācārena te pajahāti, na kadāci'pi sammisso hoti.

examples.text: saddhiṃ caram'ekato vasaṃ, misso aññajanena vedagū, vidvā pajahāti pāpakaṃ, koñco khīrapako'va ninnagan'ti.

74342.meaning1: (of a person in prayer or in mourning) without wet clothes
74342.commentary: (UDa) atha bhagavā attano adhippāyaṃ pakāsento api nu tvaṃ kadāci karahaci anallavatthā vā bhaveyyāsi anallakesā vā'ti āha. nanu evaṃ sante tayā sabbakālaṃ sok'ābhibhūtāya matānaṃ putt'ādīnaṃ amaṅgal'ūpacāravasena udak'orohaṇena allavatthāya allakesāya eva bhavitabban'ti dasseti.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, visākhe, api nu tvaṃ kadāci karahaci anallavatthā vā bhaveyyāsi anallakesā vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

74343.meaning1: (of a person in prayer or in mourning) without wet hair
74343.commentary: (UDa) api nu tvaṃ kadāci karahaci anallavatthā vā bhaveyyāsi anallakesā vā'ti āha. nanu evaṃ sante tayā sabbakālaṃ sok'ābhibhūtāya matānaṃ putt'ādīnaṃ amaṅgal'ūpacāravasena udak'orohaṇena allavatthāya allakesāya eva bhavitabban'ti dasseti.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, visākhe, api nu tvaṃ kadāci karahaci anallavatthā vā bhaveyyāsi anallakesā vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

74344.commentary: (UDa) nirodhi saññā'ti rūp'āyatan'ādigocaratāya rūpasaññ'ādi-bhedā sabbā'pi saññā appaṭisandhikena nirodhena nirujjhi.

examples.text: abhedi kāyo nirodhi saññā, vedanā sītibhaviṃsu sabbā, vūpasamiṃsu saṅkhārā, viññāṇaṃ attham'āgamā'ti.

74345.meaning1: finished; stopped; ceased; ended; is over

74346.grammar: aor of sītibhavati, comp vb, intrans
74346.commentary: (UDa) vedanā sītibhaviṃsu sabbā'ti vipākavedanā kiriyavedanā'ti sabbā'pi vedanā appaṭisandhikanirodhena niruddhattā aṇumattam'pi vedanādarathassa abhāvato sītibhūtā ahesuṃ, kusal'ākusalavedanā pana arahattaphalakkhaṇe'y'eva nirodhaṃ gatā. sītirahiṃsū'ti'pi paṭhan'ti, santā niruddhā ahesun'ti attho.

examples.text: abhedi kāyo nirodhi saññā, vedanā sītibhaviṃsu sabbā, vūpasamiṃsu saṅkhārā, viññāṇaṃ attham'āgamā'ti.

74347.grammar: imperf of atthaṃ gacchati, comp vb
74347.commentary: (UDa) viññāṇaṃ attham'āgamā'ti viññāṇam'pi vipākakiriyappabhedaṃ sabbaṃ appaṭisandhikanirodhen'eva atthaṃ vināsaṃ upacchedaṃ agamā agacchi.

examples.text: abhedi kāyo nirodhi saññā, vedanā sītibhaviṃsu sabbā, vūpasamiṃsu saṅkhārā, viññāṇaṃ attham'āgamā'ti.

74348.meaning1: struck by an iron hammer; beaten with a sledgehammer
74348.commentary: (UDa) ayoghanahatassā'ti ayo haññati etenā'ti ayoghanaṃ, kammārānaṃ ayokūṭaṃ ayomuṭṭhi ca. tena ayoghanena hatassa pahatassa. keci pana ayoghanahatassā'ti ghanaayopiṇḍaṃ hatassā'ti atthaṃ vadanti.

examples.text: ayoghanahatass'eva, jalato jātavedaso, anupubb'ūpasantassa, yathā na ñāyate gati.

74349.meaning1: covered with a veil of craving; submerged in a shroud of desire
74349.meaningLit: covered with the covering of craving
74349.commentary: (UDa) taṇhāchadanachāditā'ti taṇhāsaṅkhātena chadanena sevālapaṇakena viya udakaṃ chāditā, paṭicchannā pihitā'ti attho.

examples.text: kām'andhā jālasañchannā, taṇhāchadanachāditā, pamattabandhunā baddhā, macchā'va kumināmukhe, jarāmaraṇam'anventi, vaccho khīrapako'va mātaran'ti.

74350.meaningLit: from which knowledge is born; (or) which brings knowledge to mortals
74350.commentary: (UDa) jalato jātavedaso'ti jhāyamānassa aggissa. anādare etaṃ sāmivacanaṃ. (JAa) jātavedaṃ padahasī'ti aggiṃ gilituṃ vāyamasi. (JAa) jātavedā'ti aggiṃ ālapati. so hi jāto'va vedayati paññāyati, tasmā jātavedo'ti vuccati.
74350.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: ayoghanahatass'eva, jalato jātavedaso, anupubb'ūpasantassa, yathā na ñāyate gati.
bahum'p'etaṃ asabbhi jātaveda, yaṃ taṃ vāladhin'ābhipūjayāma, maṃs'ārahassa n'atth'ajja maṃsaṃ, naṅguṭṭham'pi bhavaṃ paṭiggahātū'ti.

74351.commentary: (UDa) jalato jātavedaso'ti jhāyamānassa aggissa. anādare etaṃ sāmivacanaṃ.
74351.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: ayoghanahatass'eva, jalato jātavedaso, anupubb'ūpasantassa, yathā na ñāyate gati.

74354.meaning1: who has crossed the flood of bondage to sensual desire
74354.commentary: (UDa) tato eva kāmapabandhasaṅkhātaṃ kām'oghaṃ bhav'ogh'ādi-bhedaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ oghañ'ca taritvā ṭhitattā kāmabandh'oghatārinaṃ

examples.text: evaṃ sammāvimuttānaṃ, kāmabandh'oghatārinaṃ, paññāpetuṃ gati n'atthi, pattānaṃ acalaṃ sukhan'ti.

74355.commentary: (UDa) tato eva kāmapabandhasaṅkhātaṃ kām'oghaṃ bhav'ogh'ādi-bhedaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ oghañ'ca taritvā ṭhitattā kāmabandh'oghatārinaṃ

examples.text: evaṃ sammāvimuttānaṃ, kāmabandh'oghatārinaṃ, paññāpetuṃ gati n'atthi, pattānaṃ acalaṃ sukhan'ti.

74357.meaning1: concerned with another's deeds; (comm) connected with the creation of an almighty god
74357.commentary: (UDa) paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā'ti paro añño issar'ādiko sabbaṃ karotī'ti evaṃ pavatta-paraṃkāra-diṭṭhi-sannissitā tāya upasaṃhitā'ti paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā.

examples.text: ahaṅ'kārapasut'āyaṃ pajā, paraṅ'kār'ūpasaṃhitā, etadeke n'ābbhaññaṃsu, na naṃ sallan'ti addasuṃ.

74358.commentary: (UDa) paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā'ti paro añño issar'ādiko sabbaṃ karotī'ti evaṃ pavatta-paraṃkāra-diṭṭhi-sannissitā tāya upasaṃhitā'ti paraṃkār'ūpasaṃhitā.

examples.text: ahaṅ'kārapasut'āyaṃ pajā, paraṅ'kār'ūpasaṃhitā, etadeke n'ābbhaññaṃsu, na naṃ sallan'ti addasuṃ.

74359.commentary: (ITIa) na pun'āyanti, imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan'ti evaṃ sahajekaṭṭhapahānekaṭṭhehi avasiṭṭhakilesehi saddhiṃ taṃ lobhaṃ anāgāmimaggena pajahitvā puna pacchā imaṃ kāmadhātusaṅkhātaṃ lokaṃ paṭisandhiggahaṇavasena kadāci'pi na āgacchanti oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ suppahīnattā. iti bhagavā anāgāmiphalena desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.

examples.text: yena lobhena luddhāse, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ, taṃ lobhaṃ samma'd'aññāya, pajahanti vipassino, pahāya na pun'āyanti, imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan'ti.

74360.meaning1: fact of being thoroughly abandoned; fact of being completely dispelled; fact of being totally eliminated
74360.construction:
su + pa + √hā > hī + na + tta
suppahīna + tta

74361.meaning1: all cases; all matters; all things
74361.commentary: (ITIa) sabb'atthesu na rajjatī'ti sabbesu atīt'ādi-vasena anekabhedabhinnesu sakkāyadhammesu na rajjati, ariyamagg'ādhigamena rāgaṃ na janeti.

examples.text: yo sabbaṃ sabbato ñatvā, sabb'atthesu na rajjati, sa ve sabbapariññā so, sabbadukkham'upaccagā'ti.

74362.meaning1: completely comprehending everything; fully understanding all
74362.notes: The commentary takes it as ablative present participle, 'from understanding everything'.

examples.text: yo sabbaṃ sabbato ñatvā, sabb'atthesu na rajjati, sa ve sabbapariññā so, sabbadukkham'upaccagā'ti.

74363.meaning1: transcended all suffering; went beyond all stress
74363.commentary: (ITIa) sabbadukkham'upaccagā'ti sabbaṃ vaṭṭadukkhaṃ accagā atikkami, samatikkamī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo sabbaṃ sabbato ñatvā, sabb'atthesu na rajjati, sa ve sabbapariññā so, sabbadukkham'upaccagā'ti.

74364.meaning1: destruction of conceit; eradication of comparing
74364.commentary: (ITIa) ye ca mānaṃ pahantvāna, vimuttā mānasaṅkhaye'ti ye pana arahattamaggena sabbaso mānaṃ pajahitvā mānassa accantasaṅkhayabhūte arahattaphale nibbāne vā tadekaṭṭha-sabbakilesa-vimuttiyā vimuttā suṭṭhu muttā. te mānaganthābhibhuno, sabbadukkham'upaccagun'ti te parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā arahanto sabbaso mānaganthaṃ mānasaṃyojanaṃ samucchedappahānena abhibhavitvā ṭhitā, anavasesaṃ vaṭṭadukkhaṃ atikkamiṃsū'ti attho. evam'etasmiṃ sattamasutte ca arahattaṃ kathitan'ti.

examples.text: ye ca mānaṃ pahantvāna, vimuttā mānasaṅkhaye, te mānaganth'ābhibhuno, sabbadukkham'upaccagun'ti.

74365.meaning1: defeating the bond of ego; conquering the tie of conceit; vanquishing the knot of comparison
74365.commentary: (ITIa) te mānaganthābhibhuno, sabbadukkham'upaccagun'ti te parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā arahanto sabbaso mānaganthaṃ mānasaṃyojanaṃ samucchedappahānena abhibhavitvā ṭhitā, anavasesaṃ vaṭṭadukkhaṃ atikkamiṃsū'ti attho. evam'etasmiṃ sattamasutte ca arahattaṃ kathitan'ti.

examples.text: ye ca mānaṃ pahantvāna, vimuttā mānasaṅkhaye, te mānaganth'ābhibhuno, sabbadukkham'upaccagun'ti.

74366.meaning1: single obstacle; one obstruction; single barrier

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekanīvaraṇam'pi samanupassāmi yena nīvaraṇena nivutā pajā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsaranti yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ

74367.commentary: (ITIa) ye ca mohaṃ pahantvāna, tamokhandhaṃ padālayun'ti ye pana ariyasāvakā pubbabhāge tadaṅg'ādippahānavasena, heṭṭhimamaggehi vā taṃtaṃmaggavajjhaṃ mohaṃ pajahitvā aggamaggena vajir'ūpamañāṇena mohasaṅkhātam'eva tamorāsiṃ padālayiṃsu, anavasesato samucchindiṃsu.

examples.text: ye ca mohaṃ pahantvāna, tamokhandhaṃ padālayuṃ, na te puna saṃsaranti, hetu tesaṃ na vijjatī'ti.
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekasaṃyojanam'pi samanupassāmi yena saṃyojanena saṃyuttā sattā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsaranti yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, taṇhāsaṃyojanaṃ.

74369.commentary: (ITIa) samaggānañ'c'anuggaho'ti samaggānaṃ sāmaggianumodanena anuggaṇhanaṃ sāmaggianurūpaṃ, yathā te sāmaggiṃ na vijahanti, tathā gahaṇaṃ ṭhapanaṃ anubalappadānan'ti attho.

examples.text: sukhā saṅghassa sāmaggī, samaggānañ'c'anuggaho, samaggarato dhammaṭṭho, yogakkhemā na dhaṃsati, saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ katvāna, kappaṃ saggamhi modatī'ti.

74370.grammar: abs of na saṃvibhajati, neg, trans (+acc)
74370.meaning1: having not shared; having not divided; having not distributed
74370.construction:
na > a + saṃ + vi + √bhaj + itvā
na + saṃvibhajitvā
74370.commentary: (ITIa) tato'pi na asaṃvibhajitvā bhuñjeyyuṃ, sace nesaṃ paṭiggāhakā assū'ti nesaṃ sattānaṃ paṭiggāhakā yadi siyuṃ, tato'pi yathāvuttacarimālopato'pi saṃvibhajitvā'va ekadesaṃ datvā'va bhuñjeyyuṃ, yath'āhaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgassa vipākaṃ paccakkhato jānāmi, evaṃ yadi jāneyyun'ti.

examples.text: yo'pi nesaṃ assa carimo ālopo carimaṃ kabaḷaṃ, tato'pi na asaṃvibhajitvā bhuñjeyyuṃ, sace nesaṃ paṭiggāhakā assu.

74371.commentary: (JAa) narā saggagatā'r'ivā'ti saggagatā dibbabhogasamaṅgino narā viya te sukhaṃ vindanti.

examples.text: te ca saggagatā tattha, modanti kāmakāmino, vipākaṃ saṃvibhāgassa, anubhonti amaccharā'ti.

74372.meaning1: who indulges in sensual pleasure as one pleases

examples.text: te ca saggagatā tattha, modanti kāmakāmino, vipākaṃ saṃvibhāgassa, anubhonti amaccharā'ti.
idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, maggaṃ sugatigāminaṃ, nandino devalokasmiṃ, modanti kāmakāmino'ti.

74373.meaning1: having exceeded; having surpassed; having transcended

examples.text: yāni kānici, bhikkhave, opadhikāni puññakiriyavatthūni sabbāni tāni mettāya cetovimuttiyā kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ. mettā'y'eva tāni cetovimutti adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā sabbā tā candiyā pabhāya kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ, candapabhā'y'eva tā adhiggahetvā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

74376.meaning1: royal seer; kingly sage; wise ruler

examples.text: ye sattasaṇḍaṃ pathaviṃ vijitvā, rāj'īsayo yajamān'ānupariyagā, assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷaṃ.

74377.meaning1: development of friendliness; cultivation of mettā meditation

74378.grammar: prp of na ḍayhati, neg, pass, intrans
74378.meaning1: not being burned; not being scorched; not suffering

examples.text: aḍayhamānena kāyena, aḍayhamānena cetasā, divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ, sukhaṃ viharati tādiso'ti.

74379.commentary: (ITIa) imāni ca kāyaduccarit'ādīni kammapathappattāni adhippetānī'ti yaṃ na kammapathappattaṃ akusalajātaṃ, taṃ sandhāy'āha yañ'c'aññaṃ dosasañhitan'ti. tass'attho, yam'pi ca aññaṃ kammapathabhāvaṃ appattattā nippariyāyena kāyakamm'ādisaṅkhaṃ na labhati, rāg'ādikilesasaṃsaṭṭhattā dosasahitaṃ akusalaṃ tam'pi katvā'ti attho.

examples.text: kāyaduccaritaṃ katvā, vacīduccaritāni ca, manoduccaritaṃ katvā, yañ'c'aññaṃ dosasañhitaṃ.

74380.meaning1: frequently dull and drowsy; full of sloth and torpor
74380.commentary: (ITIa) anussāhasaṃhananasabhāvassa citt'ālasiyassa thinassa, asattivighātasabhāvassa kāy'ālasiyassa middhassa ca abhiṇhappavattiyā thinamiddhabahulo.

examples.text: anātāpī anottāpī, kusīto hīnavīriyo, yo thīnamiddhabahulo, ahirīko anādaro, abhabbo tādiso bhikkhu, phuṭṭhuṃ sambodhim'uttamaṃ.

74381.meaning1: which inspires a sense of urgency; which provokes fear
74381.commentary: (ITIa) saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesū'ti saṃvegajanakesu jāti'ādīsu saṃvegavatthūsu. jāti, jarā, byādhi, maraṇaṃ, apāyadukkhaṃ, atīte vaṭṭamūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ, anāgate vaṭṭamūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ, paccuppanne āhārapariyeṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhan'ti imāni hi saṃvegavatthūni saṃvejanīyaṭṭhānāni nāma.

examples.text: saṃvejanīyaṭṭhānesu, saṃvijjeth'eva paṇḍito, ātāpī nipako bhikkhu, paññāya samavekkhiya.

74382.meaning1: alarming; arousing urgency; jolting into action; dismaying
74382.meaning2: apt to cause emotion or anxiety
74382.commentary: (ITIa) saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesū'ti saṃvegajanakesu jāti'ādīsu saṃvegavatthūsu. jāti, jarā, byādhi, maraṇaṃ, apāyadukkhaṃ, atīte vaṭṭamūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ, anāgate vaṭṭamūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ, paccuppanne āhārapariyeṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhan'ti imāni hi saṃvegavatthūni saṃvejanīyaṭṭhānāni nāma.

examples.text: saṃvejanīyaṭṭhānesu, saṃvijjeth'eva paṇḍito, ātāpī nipako bhikkhu, paññāya samavekkhiya.

74383.meaning1: with a calm way of being; with a peaceful lifestyle

examples.text: evaṃ vihārī ātāpī, santavutti anuddhato, cetosamatham'anuyutto, khayaṃ dukkhassa pāpuṇe'ti.

74384.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from na kuheti, neg
74384.meaning1: not cheating; not deceiving; not misleading; not creating a false impression

examples.text: tamonudaṃ pāragataṃ mah'esiṃ, taṃ pattipattaṃ vasimaṃ anāsavaṃ, visantaraṃ taṇhakkhaye vimuttaṃ, taṃ ve muniṃ antimadehadhāriṃ, mānajahaṃ brūmi jarāya pāraguṃ.

74386.meaning1: rooted in ignorance; based on not understanding
74386.commentary: (ITIa) avijjāmūlikā sabbā'ti tā sabbā'pi duccaritassa vipattiyo vuttanayena avijjāpubbaṅ'gamattā avijjāmūlikā eva.

examples.text: yā kāc'imā duggatiyo, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca, avijjāmūlikā sabbā, icchālobhasamussayā.

74387.meaning1: fact of preceding; fact of being a forerunner
74387.commentary: (VIBHt) kulāpadese jātimā pur'issaro hotī'ti pubbaṅ'gamattā cittassa visiṭṭhajātisadisatā'ti vuttaṃ. vicāraṇāpaññāhetukattā mantassa vīmaṃsāsadisatā suviññeyyā'vā'ti na uddhaṭā.

74388.meaning1: accumulation of desire and greed; mass of longing and desire
74388.commentary: (ITIa) icchālobhasamussayā'ti asampatta-visaya-pariyesana-lakkhaṇāya icchāya, sampattavisaya-lubbhana-lakkhaṇena lobhena ca samussitā upacitā'ti icchālobhasamussayā.

examples.text: yā kāc'imā duggatiyo, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca, avijjāmūlikā sabbā, icchālobhasamussayā.

74389.synonym: uccaya, puñja, saṅghāṭa, saṅghāta, sannicaya, samūha
74389.commentary: (ITIa) icchālobhasamussayā'ti asampatta-visaya-pariyesana-lakkhaṇāya icchāya, sampattavisaya-lubbhana-lakkhaṇena lobhena ca samussitā upacitā'ti icchālobhasamussayā.

examples.text: yā kāc'imā duggatiyo, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca, avijjāmūlikā sabbā, icchālobhasamussayā.

74390.meaning1: leading to penetration; which culminates in breakthrough
74390.commentary: (ITIa) sā hi kilesakkhandhaṃ vinivijjhantī gacchati pavattatī'ti nibbedhagāminī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: paññā hi seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ, yāyaṃ nibbedhagāminī, yāya sammā pajānāti, jātibhavaparikkhayaṃ.

74392.meaning1: extinction of rebirth and becoming; exhaustion of birth and being

examples.text: paññā hi seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ, yāyaṃ nibbedhagāminī, yāya sammā pajānāti, jātibhavaparikkhayaṃ.

74393.meaning1: birth and being; rebirth and becoming

examples.text: paññā hi seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ, yāyaṃ nibbedhagāminī, yāya sammā pajānāti, jātibhavaparikkhayaṃ.

74394.commentary: (ITIa) vokkantā sukkamūlā te'ti te sattā kusalamūlapacchedāvahassā'pi kammassa karaṇato kusalakammānaṃ patiṭṭhānabhūtānaṃ hir'ottappānam'eva vā abhāvato kusalato vokkamitvā, apasakkitvā, ṭhitattā vokkantā sukkamūlā, punappunaṃ jāyanamīyanasabhāvattā jātimaraṇagāmino saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattantī'ti attho.

examples.text: yesaṃ ce hiriottappaṃ, sabbadā ca na vijjati, vokkantā sukkamūlā te, jātimaraṇagāmino.

74395.meaning1: fact of having a certain nature; fact of having an innate disposition

74397.meaning1: developed in the holy life; mature on the spiritual path; flourished in spiritual practice

examples.text: yesañ'ca hiriottappaṃ, sadā sammā upaṭṭhitā, virūḷhabrahmacariyā te, santo khīṇapunabbhavā'ti.

74398.meaning1: conglomeration of old age and death; assemblage of aging and dying

examples.text: jātaṃ bhūtaṃ samuppannaṃ, kataṃ saṅkhatam'addhuvaṃ, jarāmaraṇasaṅghāṭaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ.

74399.meaning1: who has completed the training; who has perfected the practice; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: paripuṇṇasikkhaṃ apahānadhammaṃ, paññ'uttaraṃ jātikhay'antadassiṃ, taṃ ve muniṃ antimadehadhāriṃ, mārañ'jahaṃ brūmi jarāya pāraguṃ.
